newsitem.title: USA: SunPharm closes $6.4 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: SunPharm closes $6.4 mln private placement.

text.p: SunPharm Corp said Thursday that it has closed on a private placement of 1.83 million units with gross proceeds of approximately $6.4 million. Each unit consists of one share of SunPharm common stock and a warrant to purchase one additional share.
The proceeds of the private placement provide SunPharm with funding for two years of operations, said SunPharm.

The company added that it will use the money to accelerate its product and organizational development programs, and its three human clinical trial programs underway for the proprietary polyamine analogue-based products.
The company also said that it named Charles Dimmler, of Hambro Health International Inc to a new seat on its board of directors.
